description: Source code implementing QPSK demodulation with SIMD optimizations for AVX2 and ARM NEON, including functions for soft demodulation and symbol processing.

methods.name: demod_QPSK_avx2
methods.description: Performs QPSK demodulation using AVX2 instructions, processing 16 symbols at a time.

methods.name: demod_QPSK_neon
methods.description: Performs QPSK demodulation using ARM NEON instructions, processing 8 symbols at a time.

methods.name: demod_QPSK_symbol
methods.description: Calculates the log-likelihood ratio for a single QPSK symbol given its real or imaginary part and noise variance.

methods.name: ocudu::demodulate_soft_QPSK
methods.description: Main function to demodulate a span of QPSK symbols into soft LLRs, utilizing SIMD optimizations and handling remainders.
